A runtime that is not the compiler reads the very JSON file a `@text`\nfn renders (§2.9, WIRE.md §8.5) through the generated decoder of its result type:\n`os.ReadFile` then `gotypes.DecodeItemFile(raw)`.\n\nA `@text` fn whose result is a map, a list or a keyed list gets\n`Decode<Fn>File(raw []byte) (T, error)` instead (DECISIONS 340): `DecodeRaritiesFile`.\n\n`open` (DECISIONS 339) lists the enums a consumer must keep reading when the file holds a\nmember it does not know yet: each is a `string` type of wire values with `Known()`, and its\ndecoders keep any string. `Element` is opened too, but its file holds codes: a code no member\nhas still fails.\n\nThe emit is written as two copies (§2.1), each under a root of its own with its own Go\nmodule path, so each consumer imports its own copy and its own `rt`." @1:1-16:73
